verdict: For one person's meal, roti telur is lower in calories. Murtabak ayam is high in protein, but better for sharing.
why: Roti telur is about 400 kcal, murtabak ayam around 700 kcal for 4 pieces. A difference of 300 kcal.
Murtabak has more protein (35 g vs 14 g), so it really is more filling.
Murtabak has about 33 g fat compared to 20 g in roti telur, because of more oil and filling.
If you share a murtabak, 2 pieces are about 350 kcal with 17 g protein. That's on par with, or even better than, roti telur.
when_a: Murtabak ayam is okay when you share it with someone, or when it's your main meal and you skip rice.
when_b: Roti telur suits breakfast or a light dinner when you're eating alone.
tip: If you order murtabak, ask to pack half for tomorrow. Eat it with the cucumber and onion acar, and go easy on the curry gravy.

faq.q: Murtabak is high in protein, so isn't it good for weight loss?
faq.a: Protein is great for keeping you full. But total calories still matter. Share it or eat half for a better balance.

faq.q: Is roti telur with teh tarik okay?
faq.a: Okay once in a while. To save calories, switch to teh O kurang manis (black tea, less sweet) or plain water.
